messages:
mira: Quick sync 10 on the alert preview microcopy and suppression behavior. Prototype attached. Thoughts?
devon: First impression: preview line 'Notifies X channels' feels terse. Users asked "which ones?" in testing. Maybe list first two then +N.
ash: Agree. Suggest "Will notify: #alerts, #infra, +2 more" and make the channel chips clickable to jump to settings.
mira: Good. Also, if a channel is suppressed, current flow hides it from the preview. That confused a customer yesterday. I'd rather show suppressed channels with a clear label.
devon: Show suppressed channels but mark them: small slash icon + "suppressed until 16:00" tooltip. Keep them lower contrast but ensure 4.5:1.
ash: Accessibility note: icon alone is ambiguous. Add aria-describedby that reads the suppression reason/time. Example label: "Slack channel #alerts, notifications off, suppressed until 4 PM".
a11y-bot: Reminder: when truncating visual names, keep the full text in the aria-label for screen readers. Test with VO and NVDA.
mira: Copy tweak for empty preview: change "No channels will be notified" -> "No channels selected for this alert. Add channels to notify." Slight nudge to action.
devon: UX flow: clicking a suppressed chip should open a small popover with reasons and an "unsnooze" action. That helps auditability.
mira: OK team. I'll update the mock: 1) show first two channels +N, 2) suppressed chips visible with label and tooltip, 3) updated empty copy. I'll run a quick a11y pass after patch. Thanks.
